verses.original: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ Λόγος καὶ ὁ Λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν Θεόν καὶ Θεὸς ἦν ὁ Λόγος
verses.transliteration: En archē ēn ho Logos kai ho Logos ēn pros ton Theon kai Theos ēn ho Logos
verses.literal: In the beginning was the Word and the Word was with God and the Word was God
verses.literalPt: NO princípio era o Verbo, e o Verbo estava com Deus, e o Verbo era Deus.

verses.original: Οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Houtos ēn en archē pros ton Theon
verses.literal: He was with God in the beginning
verses.literalPt: Ele estava no princípio com Deus.

verses.original: πάντα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο οὐδὲ ἕν ὃ γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: panta di’ autou egeneto kai chōris autou egeneto oude hen ho gegonen
verses.literal: Through Him all things were made and without Him nothing . . . was made that has been made
verses.literalPt: Todas as coisas foram feitas por ele, e sem ele nada do que foi feito se fez.

verses.original: ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἦν τὸ φῶς τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: en autō zōē ēn kai hē zōē ēn to phōs tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: In Him was life and that life was the light of men
verses.literalPt: Nele estava a vida, e a vida era a luz dos homens.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει καὶ ἡ σκοτία αὐτὸ οὐ κατέλαβεν
verses.transliteration: kai to phōs en tē skotia phainei kai hē skotia auto ou katelaben
verses.literal: The Light shines in the darkness and the darkness has not overcome it
verses.literalPt: E a luz resplandece nas trevas, e as trevas não a compreenderam.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο ἄνθρωπος ἀπεσταλμένος παρὰ Θεοῦ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: Egeneto anthrōpos apestalmenos para Theou onoma autō Iōannēs
verses.literal: There came a man who was sent from God His name was John
verses.literalPt: Houve um homem enviado de Deus, cujo nome era João.

verses.original: οὗτος ἦλθεν εἰς μαρτυρίαν ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός ἵνα πάντες πιστεύσωσιν δι’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos ēlthen eis martyrian hina martyrēsē peri tou phōtos hina pantes pisteusōsin di’ autou
verses.literal: He came as a witness to testify about the Light so that through him everyone might believe
verses.literalPt: Este veio para testemunho, para que testificasse da luz, para que todos cressem por ele.

verses.original: οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖνος τὸ φῶς ἀλλ’ ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός
verses.transliteration: ouk ēn ekeinos to phōs all’ hina martyrēsē peri tou phōtos
verses.literal: He himself was not the Light but he came to testify about the Light
verses.literalPt: Não era ele a luz, mas para que testificasse da luz.

verses.original: Ἦν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ὃ φωτίζει πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐρχόμενον εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: Ēn to phōs to alēthinon ho phōtizei panta anthrōpon erchomenon eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: The true Light who gives light to everyone . . . was coming into the world
verses.literalPt: Ali estava a luz verdadeira, que ilumina a todo o homem que vem ao mundo.

verses.original: ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἦν καὶ ὁ κόσμος δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτὸν οὐκ ἔγνω
verses.transliteration: en tō kosmō ēn kai ho kosmos di’ autou egeneto kai ho kosmos auton ouk egnō
verses.literal: He was in the world and though the world was made through Him the world did not recognize Him
verses.literalPt: Estava no mundo, e o mundo foi feito por ele, e o mundo não o conheceu.

verses.original: εἰς τὰ ἴδια ἦλθεν καὶ οἱ ἴδιοι αὐτὸν οὐ παρέλαβον
verses.transliteration: eis ta idia ēlthen kai hoi idioi auton ou parelabon
verses.literal: He came to His own and His own did not receive Him
verses.literalPt: Veio para o que era seu, e os seus não o receberam.

verses.original: ὅσοι δὲ ἔλαβον αὐτόν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα Θεοῦ γενέσθαι τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hosoi de elabon auton edōken autois exousian tekna Theou genesthai tois pisteuousin eis to onoma autou
verses.literal: But to all who did receive Him to those who believed in His name He gave the right to become children of God
verses.literalPt: Mas, a todos quantos o receberam, deu-lhes o poder de serem feitos filhos de Deus, aos que crêem no seu nome;

verses.original: οἳ οὐκ ἐξ αἱμάτων οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος σαρκὸς οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος ἀνδρὸς ἀλλ’ ἐκ Θεοῦ ἐγεννήθησαν
verses.transliteration: hoi ouk ex haimatōn oude ek thelēmatos sarkos oude ek thelēmatos andros all’ ek Theou egennēthēsan
verses.literal: children born not of blood nor of the desire . . . or will of man but born of God
verses.literalPt: Os quais não nasceram do sangue, nem da vontade da carne, nem da vontade do homem, mas de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Λόγος σὰρξ ἐγένετο καὶ ἐσκήνωσεν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ἐθεασάμεθα τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ δόξαν ὡς μονογενοῦς παρὰ Πατρός πλήρης χάριτος καὶ ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Logos sarx egeneto kai eskēnōsen en hēmin kai etheasametha tēn doxan autou doxan hōs monogenous para Patros plērēs charitos kai alētheias
verses.literal: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us We have seen His glory the glory of the one and only Son from the Father full of grace and truth
verses.literalPt: E o Verbo se fez carne, e habitou entre nós, e vimos a sua glória, como a glória do unigênito do Pai, cheio de graça e de verdade.

verses.original: Ἰωάννης μαρτυρεῖ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κέκραγεν λέγων Οὗτος ἦν ὃν εἶπον Ὁ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν
verses.transliteration: Iōannēs martyrei peri autou kai kekragen legōn Houtos ēn hon eipon Ho opisō mou erchomenos emprosthen mou gegonen hoti prōtos mou ēn
verses.literal: John testified concerning Him He cried out saying This is He of whom I said He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me
verses.literalPt: João testificou dele, e clamou, dizendo: Este era aquele de quem eu dizia: O que vem após mim é antes de mim, porque foi primeiro do que eu.

verses.original: Ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πληρώματος αὐτοῦ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἐλάβομεν καὶ χάριν ἀντὶ χάριτος
verses.transliteration: Hoti ek tou plērōmatos autou hēmeis pantes elabomen kai charin anti charitos
verses.literal: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace
verses.literalPt: E todos nós recebemos também da sua plenitude, e graça por graça.

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ νόμος διὰ Μωϋσέως ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: hoti ho nomos dia Mōuseōs edothē hē charis kai hē alētheia dia Iēsou Christou egeneto
verses.literal: For the law was given through Moses grace and truth came through Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque a lei foi dada por Moisés; a graça e a verdade vieram por Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Θεὸν οὐδεὶς ἑώρακεν πώποτε μονογενὴς Θεὸς ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐκεῖνος ἐξηγήσατο
verses.transliteration: Theon oudeis heōraken pōpote monogenēs Theos ho ōn eis ton kolpon tou Patros ekeinos exēgēsato
verses.literal: No one has ever seen . . . God but the one and only Son who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side has made Him known
verses.literalPt: Deus nunca foi visto por alguém. O Filho unigênito, que está no seio do Pai, esse o revelou.

verses.original: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Ἰωάννου ὅτε ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐξ Ἱεροσολύμων ἱερεῖς καὶ Λευίτας ἵνα ἐρωτήσωσιν αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ
verses.transliteration: Kai hautē estin hē martyria tou Iōannou hote apesteilan pros auton hoi Ioudaioi ex Hierosolymōn hiereis kai Leuitas hina erōtēsōsin auton Sy tis ei
verses.literal: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent - priests and Levites to ask him Who are you
verses.literalPt: E este é o testemunho de João, quando os judeus mandaram de Jerusalém sacerdotes e levitas para que lhe perguntassem: Quem és tu?

verses.original: καὶ ὡμολόγησεν καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσατο καὶ ὡμολόγησεν ὅτι Ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: kai hōmologēsen kai ouk ērnēsato kai hōmologēsen hoti Egō ouk eimi ho Christos
verses.literal: He did not refuse to confess . . . . . . . . . but openly declared I am not the Christ
verses.literalPt: E confessou, e não negou; confessou: Eu não sou o Cristo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν Τί οὖν σὺ Ἠλίας εἶ Καὶ λέγει Οὐκ εἰμί Ὁ προφήτης εἶ σύ Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Οὔ
verses.transliteration: Kai ērōtēsan auton Ti oun sy Ēlias ei Kai legei Ouk eimi Ho prophētēs ei sy Kai apekrithē Ou
verses.literal: Then who are you they inquired . . . Are you Elijah He said I am not Are you the Prophet He answered No
verses.literalPt: E perguntaram-lhe: Então quê? És tu Elias? E disse: Não sou. És tu profeta? E respondeu: Não.

verses.original: Εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ Τίς εἶ ἵνα ἀπόκρισιν δῶμεν τοῖς πέμψασιν ἡμᾶς τί λέγεις περὶ σεαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipan oun autō Tis ei hina apokrisin dōmen tois pempsasin hēmas ti legeis peri seautou
verses.literal: So they said to him Who are you We need an answer for those who sent us What do you say about yourself
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és? para que demos resposta àqueles que nos enviaram; que dizes de ti mesmo?

verses.original: Ἔφη Ἐγὼ φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Εὐθύνατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου καθὼς εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας ὁ προφήτης
verses.transliteration: Ephē Egō phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Euthynate tēn hodon Kyriou kathōs eipen Ēsaias ho prophētēs
verses.literal: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness Make straight the way for the Lord
verses.literalPt: Disse: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto: Endireitai o caminho do Senhor, como disse o profeta Isaías.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπεσταλμένοι ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων
verses.transliteration: Kai apestalmenoi ēsan ek tōn Pharisaiōn
verses.literal: Then the Pharisees who had been sent . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E os que tinham sido enviados eram dos fariseus.

verses.original: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν βαπτίζεις εἰ σὺ οὐκ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐδὲ Ἠλίας οὐδὲ ὁ προφήτης
verses.transliteration: kai ērōtēsan auton kai eipan autō Ti oun baptizeis ei sy ouk ei ho Christos oude Ēlias oude ho prophētēs
verses.literal: asked him - Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ nor Elijah nor the Prophet
verses.literalPt: E perguntaram-lhe, e disseram-lhe: Por que batizas, pois, se tu não és o Cristo, nem Elias, nem o profeta?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰωάννης λέγων Ἐγὼ βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι μέσος ὑμῶν ἕστηκεν ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iōannēs legōn Egō baptizō en hydati mesos hymōn hestēken hon hymeis ouk oidate
verses.literal: I baptize with water John replied . . . . . . but among you stands One you do not know
verses.literalPt: João respondeu-lhes, dizendo: Eu batizo com água; mas no meio de vós está um a quem vós não conheceis.

verses.original: ὁ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἄξιος ἵνα λύσω αὐτοῦ τὸν ἱμάντα τοῦ ὑποδήματος
verses.transliteration: ho opisō mou erchomenos hou ouk eimi egō axios hina lysō autou ton himanta tou hypodēmatos
verses.literal: He is the One who comes after me the straps of whose - sandals I am not worthy to untie
verses.literalPt: Este é aquele que vem após mim, que é antes de mim, do qual eu não sou digno de desatar a correia da alparca.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐγένετο πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ὅπου ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων
verses.transliteration: Tauta en Bēthania egeneto peran tou Iordanou hopou ēn ho Iōannēs baptizōn
verses.literal: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan where John was baptizing
verses.literalPt: Estas coisas aconteceram em Betânia, do outro lado do Jordão, onde João estava batizando.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον βλέπει τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ λέγει Ἴδε ὁ Ἀμνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Tē epaurion blepei ton Iēsoun erchomenon pros auton kai legei Ide ho Amnos tou Theou ho airōn tēn hamartian tou kosmou
verses.literal: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said Look the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte João viu a Jesus, que vinha para ele, e disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον Ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεται ἀνὴρ ὃς ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν
verses.transliteration: houtos estin hyper hou egō eipon Opisō mou erchetai anēr hos emprosthen mou gegonen hoti prōtos mou ēn
verses.literal: This is He of whom I said A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me
verses.literalPt: Este é aquele do qual eu disse: Após mim vem um homem que é antes de mim, porque foi primeiro do que eu.

verses.original: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν ἀλλ’ ἵνα φανερωθῇ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον ἐγὼ ἐν ὕδατι βαπτίζων
verses.transliteration: kagō ouk ēdein auton all’ hina phanerōthē tō Israēl dia touto ēlthon egō en hydati baptizōn
verses.literal: I myself did not know Him but the reason . . . I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel
verses.literalPt: E eu não o conhecia; mas, para que ele fosse manifestado a Israel, vim eu, por isso, batizando com água.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν Ἰωάννης λέγων ὅτι Τεθέαμαι τὸ Πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον ὡς περιστερὰν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai emartyrēsen Iōannēs legōn hoti Tetheamai to Pneuma katabainon hōs peristeran ex ouranou kai emeinen ep’ auton
verses.literal: Then John testified . . . I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him
verses.literalPt: E João testificou, dizendo: Eu vi o Espírito descer do céu como pomba, e repousar sobre ele.

verses.original: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με βαπτίζειν ἐν ὕδατι ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἐφ’ ὃν ἂν ἴδῃς τὸ Πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον καὶ μένον ἐπ’ αὐτόν οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: kagō ouk ēdein auton all’ ho pempsas me baptizein en hydati ekeinos moi eipen Eph’ hon an idēs to Pneuma katabainon kai menon ep’ auton houtos estin ho baptizōn en Pneumati Hagiō
verses.literal: I myself did not know Him but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me The man on whom . . . you see the Spirit descend and rest - is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: E eu não o conhecia, mas o que me mandou a batizar com água, esse me disse: Sobre aquele que vires descer o Espírito, e sobre ele repousar, esse é o que batiza com o Espírito Santo.

verses.original: κἀγὼ ἑώρακα καὶ μεμαρτύρηκα ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kagō heōraka kai memartyrēka hoti houtos estin ho Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God
verses.literalPt: E eu vi, e tenho testificado que este é o Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον πάλιν εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰωάννης καὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο
verses.transliteration: Tē epaurion palin heistēkei ho Iōannēs kai ek tōn mathētōn autou dyo
verses.literal: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte João estava outra vez ali, e dois dos seus discípulos;

verses.original: καὶ ἐμβλέψας τῷ Ἰησοῦ περιπατοῦντι λέγει Ἴδε ὁ Ἀμνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai emblepsas tō Iēsou peripatounti legei Ide ho Amnos tou Theou
verses.literal: When he saw Jesus walking by he said Look the Lamb of God
verses.literalPt: E, vendo passar a Jesus, disse: Eis aqui o Cordeiro de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ δύο μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος καὶ ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ēkousan hoi dyo mathētai autou lalountos kai ēkolouthēsan tō Iēsou
verses.literal: And when the two disciples heard him say this they followed Jesus
verses.literalPt: E os dois discípulos ouviram-no dizer isto, e seguiram a Jesus.

verses.original: Στραφεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος αὐτοὺς ἀκολουθοῦντας λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί ζητεῖτε Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ῥαββί ὃ λέγεται μεθερμηνευόμενον Διδάσκαλε Ποῦ μένεις
verses.transliteration: Strapheis de ho Iēsous kai theasamenos autous akolouthountas legei autois Ti zēteite Hoi de eipan autō Rhabbi ho legetai methermēneuomenon Didaskale Pou meneis
verses.literal: Jesus turned and saw them following What do you want He asked - They said to Him Rabbi (which means . . . Teacher) where are You staying
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, voltando-se e vendo que eles o seguiam, disse-lhes: Que buscais? E eles disseram: Rabi (que, traduzido, quer dizer Mestre), onde moras?

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἔρχεσθε καὶ ὄψεσθε ἦλθαν οὖν καὶ εἶδαν ποῦ μένει καὶ παρ’ αὐτῷ ἔμειναν τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην ὥρα ἦν ὡς δεκάτη
verses.transliteration: Legei autois Erchesthe kai opsesthe ēlthan oun kai eidan pou menei kai par’ autō emeinan tēn hēmeran ekeinēn hōra ēn hōs dekatē
verses.literal: Come and see He replied So they went and saw where He was staying and spent that day with Him It was about the tenth hour
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes disse: Vinde, e vede. Foram, e viram onde morava, e ficaram com ele aquele dia; e era já quase a hora décima.

verses.original: Ἦν Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου εἷς ἐκ τῶν δύο τῶν ἀκουσάντων παρὰ Ἰωάννου καὶ ἀκολουθησάντων αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ēn Andreas ho adelphos Simōnos Petrou heis ek tōn dyo tōn akousantōn para Iōannou kai akolouthēsantōn autō
verses.literal: Andrew Simon Peter’s brother was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus
verses.literalPt: Era André, irmão de Simão Pedro, um dos dois que ouviram aquilo de João, e o haviam seguido.

verses.original: εὑρίσκει οὗτος πρῶτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τὸν ἴδιον Σίμωνα καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Εὑρήκαμεν τὸν Μεσσίαν ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Χριστός
verses.transliteration: heuriskei houtos prōton ton adelphon ton idion Simōna kai legei autō Heurēkamen ton Messian ho estin methermēneuomenon Christos
verses.literal: He first found his . . . brother Simon and told him We have found the Messiah (which is translated as Christ)
verses.literalPt: Este achou primeiro a seu irmão Simão, e disse-lhe: Achamos o Messias (que, traduzido, é o Cristo).

verses.original: ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Σὺ εἶ Σίμων ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωάννου σὺ κληθήσῃ Κηφᾶς ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται Πέτρος
verses.transliteration: Ēgagen auton pros ton Iēsoun emblepsas autō ho Iēsous eipen Sy ei Simōn ho huios Iōannou sy klēthēsē Kēphas ho hermēneuetai Petros
verses.literal: Andrew brought him to Jesus who looked at him and said You are Simon son of John You will be called Cephas (which is translated as Peter)
verses.literalPt: E levou-o a Jesus. E, olhando Jesus para ele, disse: Tu és Simão, filho de Jonas; tu serás chamado Cefas (que quer dizer Pedro).

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ἠθέλησεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ εὑρίσκει Φίλιππον καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: Tē epaurion ēthelēsen exelthein eis tēn Galilaian kai heuriskei Philippon kai legei autō ho Iēsous Akolouthei moi
verses.literal: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee Finding Philip - He told him Follow Me
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte quis Jesus ir à Galiléia, e achou a Filipe, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδά ἐκ τῆς πόλεως Ἀνδρέου καὶ Πέτρου
verses.transliteration: ēn de ho Philippos apo Bēthsaida ek tēs poleōs Andreou kai Petrou
verses.literal: Now Philip was from Bethsaida the same town as Andrew and Peter
verses.literalPt: E Filipe era de Betsaida, cidade de André e de Pedro.

verses.original: Εὑρίσκει Φίλιππος τὸν Ναθαναὴλ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὃν ἔγραψεν Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ καὶ οἱ προφῆται εὑρήκαμεν Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέτ
verses.transliteration: Heuriskei Philippos ton Nathanaēl kai legei autō Hon egrapsen Mōusēs en tō nomō kai hoi prophētai heurēkamen Iēsoun huion tou Iōsēph ton apo Nazaret
verses.literal: Philip found Nathanael and told him We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law the One the prophets foretold Jesus of Nazareth the son of Joseph
verses.literalPt: Filipe achou Natanael, e disse-lhe: Havemos achado aquele de quem Moisés escreveu na lei, e os profetas: Jesus de Nazaré, filho de José.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Ἐκ Ναζαρὲτ δύναταί τι ἀγαθὸν εἶναι Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Φίλιππος Ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autō Nathanaēl Ek Nazaret dynatai ti agathon einai Legei autō ho Philippos Erchou kai ide
verses.literal: Can anything good come from Nazareth Nathanael asked Come and see said Philip
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Natanael: Pode vir alguma coisa boa de Nazaré? Disse-lhe Filipe: Vem, e vê.

verses.original: Εἶδεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Ναθαναὴλ ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει περὶ αὐτοῦ Ἴδε ἀληθῶς Ἰσραηλίτης ἐν ᾧ δόλος οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: Eiden ho Iēsous ton Nathanaēl erchomenon pros auton kai legei peri autou Ide alēthōs Israēlitēs en hō dolos ouk estin
verses.literal: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching . . . . . . He said of him Here is a true Israelite in whom there is no deceit
verses.literalPt: Jesus viu Natanael vir ter com ele, e disse dele: Eis aqui um verdadeiro israelita, em quem não há dolo.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Πόθεν με γινώσκεις Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πρὸ τοῦ σε Φίλιππον φωνῆσαι ὄντα ὑπὸ τὴν συκῆν εἶδόν σε
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Nathanaēl Pothen me ginōskeis Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Pro tou se Philippon phōnēsai onta hypo tēn sykēn eidon se
verses.literal: How do You know me Nathanael asked Jesus replied - Before Philip called you I saw you under the fig tree
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Natanael: De onde me conheces tu? Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Antes que Filipe te chamasse, te vi eu, estando tu debaixo da figueira.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Ῥαββί σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ σὺ Βασιλεὺς εἶ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō Nathanaēl Rhabbi sy ei ho Huios tou Theou sy Basileus ei tou Israēl
verses.literal: Rabbi Nathanael answered You are the Son of God You are the King of Israel
verses.literalPt: Natanael respondeu, e disse-lhe: Rabi, tu és o Filho de Deus; tu és o Rei de Israel.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὅτι εἶπόν σοι ὅτι εἶδόν σε ὑποκάτω τῆς συκῆς πιστεύεις μείζω τούτων ὄψῃ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Hoti eipon soi hoti eidon se hypokatō tēs sykēs pisteueis meizō toutōn opsē
verses.literal: Jesus - said to him Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree You will see greater things than these
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Porque te disse: Vi-te debaixo da figueira, crês? Coisas maiores do que estas verás.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὄψεσθε τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγότα καὶ τοὺς ἀγγέλους τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀναβαίνοντας καὶ καταβαίνοντας ἐπὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Amēn amēn legō hymin opsesthe ton ouranon aneōgota kai tous angelous tou Theou anabainontas kai katabainontas epi ton Huion tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: Then He declared . . . Truly truly I tell you you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que daqui em diante vereis o céu aberto, e os anjos de Deus subindo e descendo sobre o Filho do homem.
